step_1.title: Step 1: Visit the Parivahan website ([https://parivahan
step_1.chatText: Step 1: Visit the Parivahan website ([https://parivahan.gov.in/](https://parivahan.gov.in/)) and click on the 'Driving License Related Services' section

step_2.title: Step 2
step_2.chatText: Step 2: Select the 'Appointment for License' option and fill out the required information

step_3.title: Step 3
step_3.chatText: Step 3: Upload the required documentation (valid driving license and proof of residence in Mumbai)

step_4.title: Step 4
step_4.chatText: Step 4: Wait for the appointment confirmation and schedule a visit to the RTO office in Mumbai

step_5.title: Step 5
step_5.chatText: Step 5: Visit the RTO office and submit the application in person

step_6.title: Step 6
step_6.chatText: Step 6: Wait for the processing and issuance of the new driving license
